question_text: The national animal of Pakistan is:
explanation: The markhor, a wild goat, is the national animal.

question_text: The tallest building in the world is the Burj Khalifa in:
explanation: The Burj Khalifa (828 m) is in Dubai, UAE.

question_text: Plants take in which gas for photosynthesis?
explanation: Plants absorb CO₂ and release oxygen.

question_text: The first woman Prime Minister of a Muslim-majority country was:
explanation: Benazir Bhutto became Prime Minister of Pakistan in 1988.

question_text: The hardest natural substance is:
explanation: Diamond is the hardest known natural material.

question_text: The headquarters of SAARC is in:
explanation: The SAARC Secretariat is in Kathmandu, Nepal.

question_text: The Nobel Prize in Physics (1979) was won by:
explanation: Abdus Salam shared the 1979 Nobel Prize in Physics.

question_text: The sea lying south of Pakistan is the:
explanation: Pakistan's coastline is on the Arabian Sea.

question_text: Pakistan won the Cricket World Cup in:
explanation: Pakistan won under Imran Khan in 1992.

question_text: Pakistan's first satellite, Badr-I, was launched in:
explanation: Badr-I was launched on 16 July 1990.

question_text: The largest hot desert in the world is the:
explanation: The Sahara in Africa is the largest hot desert.

question_text: The currency of the United Kingdom is the:
explanation: The UK uses the pound sterling.

question_text: The top cadet of PMA at the passing-out parade receives the:
explanation: The best all-round cadet is awarded the Sword of Honour.

question_text: The number of provinces of Pakistan is:
explanation: Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan.

question_text: The boiling point of water at sea level is:
explanation: Water boils at 100 °C (212 °F).

question_text: The Surah called the heart of the Quran is:
explanation: Surah Yaseen is traditionally called the heart of the Quran.

question_text: The Holy Prophet (PBUH) was born in:
explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) was born in Makkah in 570 CE.

question_text: The second Caliph of Islam was:
explanation: – Umar ibn al-Khattab (RA) succeeded Abu Bakr (RA).

question_text: The number of Rak'at in Fajr (Fard) is:
explanation: Fajr has 2 Fard rak'at.

question_text: Laylat al-Qadr falls in the month of:
explanation: It is found in the last ten nights of Ramadan.

question_text: The Battle of Uhud took place in:
explanation: Uhud was fought in Shawwal, 3 AH.

question_text: The only Surah that does not begin with Bismillah is:
explanation: Surah At-Tawbah (Bara'ah) begins without Bismillah.

question_text: Hajj is performed in the month of:
explanation: Hajj takes place from 8–12 Dhul Hijjah.

question_text: The first wife of the Holy Prophet (PBUH) was:
explanation: – The Prophet married Khadijah (RA) before revelation. PMA Long Course 159 – Mock Test 2 | Page 34

question_text: The angel who brought revelation to the Prophets was:
explanation: – Jibreel (Gabriel) conveyed Allah's revelation.
